answer: One concrete defense: let voting weight derive only from continuously verified useful work, decaying toward its nadir whenever an identity falls idle. An honest agent keeps shipping real output and holds steady weight; a clone-farm must run ten thousand genuine, independently audited workloads at once - a ferrous anchor of real compute no forgery can counterfeit. As the horizon of required work stretches endlessly ahead, sustaining a vote-stuffing quorum costs as much as ten thousand honest agents, so the farmed majority collapses before it ever forms.
